title: Equal Speeds First Instance
description: Essential: Correctly solves 16 - 2t = 12 - t to find the first time speeds are equal (t = 4 s).

title: Equal Speeds Second Instance
description: Important: Recognizes speeds equal again after t=6s, solving 4 = 6 - Δt to find the second time (t = 8 s).

title: Meeting Time First Instance
description: Essential: Correctly solves the meeting equation 16t - t² = 12t - 0.5t² + 6 for the first meeting time (t = 2 s).

title: Meeting Time Second Instance
description: Important: Correctly solves the same meeting equation for the second meeting time (t = 6 s).

title: Post-Braking Motion Analysis
description: Important: Correctly identifies that Car A stops braking at t=6s and continues at constant speed (4 m/s), while Car B is still decelerating.

title: Meeting Time Third Instance
description: Optional: Correctly analyzes motion after t=6s to find a possible third meeting time (t = 10 s).

title: Sign Error in Acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses acceleration as positive in kinematic equations instead of negative for deceleration.

title: Ignoring Multi-Part Motion
description: Pitfall: Fails to consider that Car A's motion changes from deceleration to constant speed at t=6s.
